info.name: 🔐 MobiKwik Recharge & Bill Payment — UAT Collection
info.description:
Complete UAT collection for MobiKwik Recharge & Bill Payment API integration.

✅ FEATURES:
• Auto RSA-2048 + AES-256-GCM hybrid encryption on every encrypted request
• Auto token generation & refresh (tracks expiry, regenerates before 30min buffer)
• Auto unique reqid generation (timestamp + random + prefix)
• Auto log saving for every request/response
• Auto-saves txId, mobikwikStamp for Status Check
• Token status indicator in console
• Full UAT log export ready for document submission

🚀 SETUP STEPS:
1. Import this collection
2. Import the MobiKwik_UAT environment
3. Fill in: CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, MEMBER_ID, RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM, KEY_VERSION
4. Run '⚙️ SETUP — Load Forge Crypto Library' request FIRST
5. Run '🔐 Token Generation > ✅ Success' to get your token
6. Run all other requests in order

📋 API EXECUTION ORDER:
Prepaid: Validation → Payment → Status Check
Postpaid: View Bill → Payment → Status Check

item.description:
POST /recharge/v3/retailerStatus

⚠️ REQUIRES ENCRYPTION.
Call this API when Recharge returns SUCCESSPENDING, timeout, or error.

Use txId = reqid from Recharge API OR mobikwikstamp from Recharge response.
LAST_TX_ID is auto-filled from the Recharge API — Status Check uses it automatically.

Status Values:
• RECHARGESUCCESS → Transaction complete
• RECHARGESUCCESSPENDING → Still pending from operator
• RECHARGEFAILURE → Transaction failed
